D5/S3/Quantum/Algebra/CommonCoefficientP.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Algebra.CommonCoefficientPlane.common_plane
D5/S3/Quantum/Algebra/CommonCoefficientP.signature: theorem common_plane (X : Fin 3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 5) ℂ) (hX : LinearIndependent ℂ X) (hinj : Function.Injective (stack X).mulVecLin) : ∃ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 3 → ℂ), finrank ℂ L = 2 ∧ ∀ T : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ, T.IsHermitian → (stack X)ᴴ * Matrix.kronecker T (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) * stack X = 0 → ∀ u ∈ L, ∀ v ∈ L, star u ⬝ᵥ (T *ᵥ v) = 0

D5/S3/Quantum/Algebra/CommonCoefficientP.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Algebra.CommonCoefficientPlane.compression_eq_sum
D5/S3/Quantum/Algebra/CommonCoefficientP.signature: theorem compression_eq_sum {a b : ℕ} (X : Fin 3 → Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℂ) (T : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) : compression X T = ∑ r, ∑ s, T r s • ((X r)ᴴ * X s)
